instruction: My preferred name is Alex. Please update the Chrome profile name to Alex.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome profile name to 'Alex'. Uses existing get_profile_name getter and exact_match metric. Same complexity as original task.

Evaluator uses exact_match metric which correctly compares result with expected value 'Alex'
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure profile name changes are persisted to disk
Getter handles multiple OS platforms (Linux, Windows, macOS) with correct file paths
Complete coverage: instruction requires updating profile name to 'Alex', evaluator verifies exactly this requirement
Logical flow is correct: postconfig refreshes state -> getter extracts profile name -> metric verifies exact match
